These five recovery-path legs still assume the monolith checkpoint layout and are red on main (no-fail-fast sweep 2026-10-25, clean extraction of d9fdaa5d).

Scope:
- tests/clone_recovery.rs::flushed_checkpoint_round_trips_through_import
- tests/clone_recovery.rs::restore_into_empty_survives_a_checkpoint_containing_a_provenance_receipt
- tests/r015_recovery_rehearsal.rs::rehearse_does_not_mutate_the_live_workspace
- tests/r015_recovery_rehearsal.rs::rehearse_survives_a_checkpoint_containing_a_provenance_receipt
- tests/checkpoint_mutation_guard.rs::fork_preserves_the_published_prefix_and_allows_later_mutations

Repair shape: pin mode=monolithic where the leg exercises the monolith/forensic path (precedent: d9fdaa5d pinned tests/attempt_outcome_round_trip.rs legs); update to the set-v2 shape where the leg should track the default (restore/rehearse/fork against a set/ checkpoint).

- All five legs pass under a mode-unpinned workspace in a clean extraction of origin/main plus this commit: cargo test --no-fail-fast --test clone_recovery --test r015_recovery_rehearsal --test checkpoint_mutation_guard.
